# How long the harness module's slow tests take on a GitHub runner (4 vCPU,
# go test -race unless the line says norace, the default MIMICRY_PROFILES),
# in seconds, the tier each test runs in, and its go test flags. Read by
# .github/scripts/harness-shard.sh to pick a CI run's tests and split them
# into shards; a test not listed counts as 2 seconds, tier core. Taken from
# the runner's logs (each shard's log has every test's --- PASS line with
# its duration, and its === RUN line; for a test whose subtests are
# parallel the --- PASS line says 0.00s, so its time is from === RUN to
# --- PASS). Parallel subtests are bound by -parallel, by default the
# runner's 4 CPUs: subtests that mostly wait on a page's own timers get
# parallel=16, or they take the sum of their subtests over 4.
#
# Tiers (.github/workflows/ci.yml picks them):
#   core      every pull request that touches code, and main
#   protocol  pull requests touching the HTTP/2, HTTP/3, QUIC or engine code
#             (the protocol paths in ci.yml), and main
#   gen       pull requests touching the generators, captures, profile data
#             or capture parsing (the gen paths in ci.yml), and main
#   main      pushes to main, the nightly run, workflow_dispatch and release
#             only: a regression here shows after the merge
# A new test lands in core, so it runs on every pull request until it is
# given a line here.
#
# A slow test needs a line here, or the shard it lands in can run past the
# 15-minute limit: `bash .github/scripts/harness-shard.sh all plan 8` prints
# main's split, `... core,protocol plan 5` a pull request's (ci.yml has each
# tier's shard count). `Test/regex` runs a slice of a test's subtests as its
# own unit (a test whose subtests alone take longer than a shard should);
# the subtests no slice matches run as one more unit. A test's lines share
# one tier and one set of flags. `TestA|TestB` (tier -) keeps tests in one
# unit when the run's tiers include them all; its members' own lines give
# their tiers, flags (which must agree), and weights when they run apart.
#
# Flags (optional, comma-separated): norace runs the test without -race,
# for a test on one goroutine or whose concurrent code other tests run
# under -race (the detector multiplied the generators' time 12-25 times
# and the page replays' 36 times, finding nothing); parallel=N runs it
# with -parallel N.
#
# seconds  tier      package          test[/subtests]       flags
# The generators run on one goroutine (no go statements or parallel
# subtests in them or the capture decoders). Without -race they took 22 s,
# 2 s, 10 s, 0.2 s, 2 s and 0.2 s on an M-series Mac (2026-11-07, every
# profile's captures); the runner is about 2.2 times slower.
50         gen       ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles     norace
5          gen       ./cmd/hellogen   TestRegenerateReadsInheritedCaptures norace
22         gen       ./cmd/h3gen      TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles     norace
2          gen       ./cmd/h3gen      TestRegenerateReadsInheritedCaptures norace
5          gen       ./cmd/kindsgen   TestRegenerateReproducesProfiles     norace
2          gen       ./cmd/kindsgen   TestRegenerateReadsInheritedCaptures norace
# Its subtests wait out each page's schedule (the longest, h3-broken, about
# 72 s); at -parallel 16 a slice takes about its longest subtest per 16.
# Estimated: to be retaken from the runner's log.
110        main      ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^chrome-.*-macos             parallel=16
110        main      ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^chrome-.*-windows           parallel=16
110        main      ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^chrome-.*-linux             parallel=16
180        main      ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^firefox-.*-(macos|windows|ios) parallel=16
110        main      ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^firefox-.*-linux            parallel=16
110        main      ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^safari-                     parallel=16
140        main      ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser/^edge-                       parallel=16
80         main      ./e2e            TestHTTP3EdgeMatchesBrowser                              parallel=16
65         main      ./e2e            TestQUICInterop
# Both replay every page capture, decoded once per test binary (pagesOnce,
# nearly all of their time): apart, each decodes them. Without -race the
# pair took 9 s on a Mac (325 s with it); their h2.Conn replays are the
# code TestConnectionMatchesBrowserTrace, the kinds and cookies tests and
# internal/h2's own tests run under -race.
30         -         ./e2e            TestChainedPrioritiesMatchBrowserTraces|TestHPACKReproducesBrowserBlocks
25         protocol  ./e2e            TestChainedPrioritiesMatchBrowserTraces norace
25         core      ./e2e            TestHPACKReproducesBrowserBlocks       norace
250        protocol  ./e2e            TestConnectionMatchesBrowserTrace
135        protocol  ./e2e            TestHTTP3DownloadMatchesBrowser
# h3-discovery waits about 51 s (its pauses and the 35 s idle) in every
# profile.
70         protocol  ./e2e            TestHTTP3MatchesBrowser                parallel=16
# One profile's download (the override is the same for every profile).
45         protocol  ./e2e            TestHTTP3ACKEvery
# The rerun without HPACK and WebSockets: 17 s on a Mac (73 s with them).
40         core      ./e2e            TestInheritedProfile
# Each socket waits out the browser's close (Chrome 2 s, about 31 s a
# profile).
45         core      ./e2e            TestWebSocketsMatchBrowser             parallel=16
# The client-hints page's script pauses (about 15 s, its subtests in
# parallel); estimated from a local run, not yet a runner's log.
20         core      ./e2e            TestClientHintsMatchesBrowser          parallel=16
15         core      ./e2e            TestConnectionsMatchBrowser
15         core      ./e2e            TestCORSMatchesBrowser
10         core      ./e2e            TestDeflateReproducesBrowserMessages
10         core      ./e2e            TestNavRedirectsMatchBrowser
6          core      ./e2e            TestResumptionMatchesBrowser
5          core      ./e2e            TestRedirects2MatchesBrowser
